nodes.name: Button Events (MQTT)
nodes.notes: Topic prefix 'awtrixNG' must match mqttPrefix in AWTRIX NG's MQTT settings.

nodes.name: Normalize Button
nodes.notes: Check AWTRIX NG's state/buttons/<button> payload format on your firmware version and adjust the isPress check if needed.

nodes.name: HA Action (Webhook)
nodes.notes: Body: {"action":"feed"|"play"|"clean"|"med"|"sleep"|"stats"}. Called from Home Assistant via rest_command.

nodes.name: Normalize Action
nodes.notes: Maps HA's {"action":"feed"} straight to the same action() call the on-device menu would eventually fire - no menu-cycling/dwell needed.

nodes.name: Clawd Engine
nodes.notes: PET_NAME is set at the top of this node's code. Edit it there.
